entities.summary: Maron, a notable figure in the history of Lebanon, associated with Hellenistic and Roman Lebanon (300–636). Preceded by Early Christianity and Byzantine Period and Seleucid and Roman Berytus. Their legacy influenced Earthquake and tsunami destroy Berytus and its law school and Battle of Yarmouk — Arab forces defeat Byzantines, opening the Levant to Islam.
